subject.title: feat(ui): modernize the Control UI dashboard

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this dashboard-wide visual refresh, including the Nova theme and a default-collapsed persisted System group, as the new Control UI baseline?
rationale: The branch is a coherent implementation using existing seams, but whether all existing users should receive these new defaults is a UX/product decision rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Sponsor the refresh
options.body: Accept the new Control UI baseline, then require focused confirmation that deep-linked active settings remain discoverable and the persisted disclosure state behaves as intended.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Request a smaller PR that isolates the Nova theme or a separately approved disclosure-navigation change from the global styling refresh.

options.title: Decline the baseline change
options.body: Keep the existing default visual language and close the proposal without treating the implementation quality as a defect.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the refresh
recommendation.body: Accept the new Control UI baseline, then require focused confirmation that deep-linked active settings remain discoverable and the persisted disclosure state behaves as intended.

likelyOwner.reason: Low-confidence historical routing signal from adjacent Control UI refresh work; an explicit current UI owner should make the final product call.
